item.title: Samarkand, the City That Changed My Route (Uzbekistan Travelogue, Part Two)
item.dc:creator: Mehran
item.description: Registan, Shah-i-Zinda, Bibi-Khanym and Ulugh Beg's observatory, and meeting two teachers from Fergana University who made me cancel my flight and stay in Uzbekistan.

item.title: From Panjakent to Bukhara: An Uzbekistan Travelogue (Part One)
item.dc:creator: Mehran
item.description: A backpacker crosses overland from Panjakent in Tajikistan into Uzbekistan: a brief night in Samarkand, the Samanid Mausoleum, Po-i-Kalyan square, Bukhara's tiled madrasas, and the traces of Rudaki and the Persian-speaking poets of this land.

item.title: Tajikistan: Nowruz in Iran's Old Home
item.dc:creator: Mehran
item.description: Nowruz 2024 in Tajikistan with a backpack and a private taxi: Dushanbe full of Persian poetry, snowy Iskanderkul lake, samanu and a Nowruz concert in Panjakent at the mayor's invitation, and the trip that made me proud to be Iranian for the first time.

item.title: Iran, Tehran: The National Botanical Garden of Iran
item.dc:creator: Mehran
item.description: An autumn morning in Iran's largest botanical garden, right by the Tehran–Karaj freeway: copper-coloured cypresses, yellow tunnels of ash trees, thorny trees by the lake, and everything you need to know before you go.

item.title: The Trip That Was Never Planned: From Bishkek to Issyk-Kul
item.dc:creator: Mehran
item.description: A backpacker on his way home to Iran through Lebanon and Syria ended up in Kyrgyzstan instead: book-reading passengers, Bishkek's hospitality, nomad yurts, the red rocks of Jeti-Oguz and a lake that never freezes.

item.title: My Journey Through the Heart of Uzbekistan: Bukhara and Samarkand
item.dc:creator: Dilnoza
item.description: Dilnoza's spring journey through Bukhara and Samarkand during Ramadan: the ancient streets of Bukhara, the 18-metre tomb of Prophet Daniel, the turquoise tiles of Shah-i-Zinda and Registan, a simple iftar on the way, and a new friendship between Uzbekistan and Iran.
